description: Nine listener/FAF-observable executions of ExprClassStaticMethod (pinned Esper 9.0.0 commit 9e1b9f1cc9117fea4bf33ab043762c045d73839c) replayed with one fresh runtime per case and the pinned EPL compiled verbatim: local (single-module inlined_class MyClass.doIt returning '|'+parameter+'|' with select s0 in the same module; one replay covers the soda=false/soda=true compile paths of ordinals 0+1), create (@public create inlined_class module plus a path-compiled select s0; covers ordinals 2+3), local-faf (MyWindow#keepall fed by an on-SupportBean merge, then a fire-and-forget query that embeds its own local inlined_class MyClass.doIt returning '>'+parameter+'<' compiled path-aware and executed twice; ordinal 5), create-faf (one module holding @public create inlined_class MyClass.doIt returning 'abc' plus the window and merge, then a path-compiled FAF query without class text executed twice; ordinal 6), local-and-create (one module with a bare local MyUtil.returnBubba class consumed by a @public create MyClass.doIt, plus a path-compiled select s0; ordinal 7), doc-samples (compile-only doc samples: local recursive MyUtility.fib, then @public create MyUtility.midPrice on a path, then a path-compiled midPrice query; ordinal 8 deploys and sends nothing, so both hosts emit zero records), invalid-compile-valid (the valid case-1 of the invalid-compile suite: empty inlined-class text compiles; ordinal 9 deploys and sends nothing, zero records), package-create (one module: create inlined_class declaring 'package mypackage;' with two-arg MyUtil.doIt plus select s0 invoking mypackage.MyUtil.doIt(theString, intPrimitive); ordinal 10), package-local (single module with a local package-qualified no-arg mypackage.MyUtil.doIt class and select s0; ordinal 12). Sends carry SupportBean with the pinned theString/intPrimitive payloads. FAF executions are replayed as compileExecuteFAF (compile path-aware plus fire-and-forget execute) twice per FAF case and each execution emits one operation 'faf' record for statement s0 with a per-execution sequence and the result rows; listener records use the per-statement sequence, engine time and scalar normalization. The compile-vs-deploy class-binding execution (ordinal 4) and the compiler inspection-option execution (ordinal 11) are intentionally-different and have no scenario case; the error-message branches of ordinal 9 are intentionally-different Janino wording and only its valid case-1 is covered.
